artworks.title: Cave of Trophonius
artworks.description: Smirke's Yale drawing of Trophonius' oracular cave — the brother with whom Agamedes built Apollo's temple and Hyrieus' trick-treasury before Agamedes' death in the trap.

artworks.title: The Hercyna and the Cave of Trophonius
artworks.description: Belle's Lebadeia landscape — the chasm that remembers the builder-brothers Agamedes and Trophonius after the treasury crime.

artworks.title: The Charioteer of Delphi
artworks.description: Delphi's bronze charioteer — the sanctuary whose early temple Pausanias credits to Agamedes and Trophonius, the Orchomenian master-builders.

popCulture.title: Agamedes
popCulture.description: Son of Erginus of Orchomenus, brother of Trophonius — co-builder of Apollo's Delphic temple and of Hyrieus' booby-trapped treasury. Not Agamedes son of Stymphalus.

popCulture.title: Trophonius
popCulture.description: Agamedes' brother and partner in the treasury theft — afterward the underground oracle of Lebadeia.

popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias records the brothers' Delphic building and the Hyrieus treasury trap that kills Agamedes — then Trophonius' subterranean cult.
